name: Programme Development

tasks.name: PDQA Need Analysis Recommendation
tasks.description: PDQA reviews the Need Analysis report and makes a recommendation. The decision and any reason for deferment or decline are captured for tracking and reporting.

tasks.name: Stakeholders Consultation
tasks.description: CDC provides relevant information related to stakeholder consultation on the need of the proposed programme. Capture organisations or companies consulted, not individual survey respondents, and upload the consultation tools and final report.

tasks.name: BOS Need Analysis Consultation
tasks.description: BOS reviews the Need Analysis report and provides a recommendation. Upload the BOS recommendation, minutes or supporting evidence and record deferment reasons where applicable.

tasks.name: APC Need Analysis Recommendation
tasks.description: The department submits the Need Analysis documentation to APC for review and APC makes a recommendation before Senate consideration.

tasks.name: Appoint Curriculum Development Committee (CDC)
tasks.description: The department identifies and appoints the Curriculum Development Coordinator and CDC members. Because CDC members are internal, capture faculty and department instead of organisation, qualification or occupation.

tasks.name: Appoint Programme Advisory Committee (PAC)
tasks.description: Capture PAC or PEC member details using the Terms of Reference sector composition. The sector field helps users check fair representation across ministry, industry, alumni, students, education providers and higher education institutions.

tasks.name: Curriculum Drafting
tasks.description: CDC develops the draft programme and submits it to PDQA for review. Upload the draft programme document before submitting.

tasks.name: Draft Curriculum and PDQA Recommendation
tasks.description: PDQA reviews and provides recommendation on the draft programme before it is circulated externally.

tasks.name: Circulation of Draft Programme
tasks.description: CDC uploads the draft programme document for circulation to PAC or PEC members identified in the programme development stage.

tasks.name: PAC / PEC Consultation and Benchmarking
tasks.description: CDC convenes a meeting with PAC or PEC members and benchmarks with peer universities and other stakeholders to solicit inputs on the draft programme.

tasks.name: Final Programme Draft and PDQA Recommendation
tasks.description: CDC circulates the final programme draft to PDQA for recommendation. PDQA confirms readiness for internal consultation or returns it for revision.

tasks.name: Internal Consultations
tasks.description: CDC identifies relevant internal stakeholders for consultation and circulates the programme document for inputs on teaching, learning, assessment, delivery, cooperative education and quality assurance. TLT is consulted by default; CE is included only where the programme has a WIL component.

tasks.name: ADS-TLT Review
tasks.description: TLT advises the department on appropriate teaching, learning and assessment strategies. CE is skipped for programmes without a WIL component.

tasks.name: CE Review
tasks.description: CE ensures the Work Integrated Learning component is properly integrated in undergraduate programmes and provides a recommendation.

tasks.name: PDQA Internal Review
tasks.description: PDQA reviews and verifies readiness of the programme for submission to BOS, makes a recommendation and provides a checklist.

tasks.name: Final Draft to BOS
tasks.description: On recommendation from PDQA, the department circulates the final draft programme for submission to BOS. Multiple documents can be uploaded, including a combined scanned support-letter pack.

tasks.name: Faculty BOS Consultation
tasks.description: BOS reviews the draft programme and makes recommendations. Record whether the programme is recommended to APC, deferred to BOSEC/BOS, or sent for other faculty consultation.

tasks.name: Other Faculty BOS Consultation
tasks.description: This step applies to multidisciplinary or interdisciplinary programmes. CDC circulates the draft programme to relevant faculties for recommendations.

tasks.name: APC Recommendation
tasks.description: APC reviews the draft programme and provides recommendations before Senate consideration.

tasks.name: Senate Recommendation
tasks.description: Senate reviews the draft programme and provides a recommendation on approval. Record deferment reasons where the programme is returned.

tasks.name: NQF Documentation
tasks.description: CDC prepares the NQF qualification documentation for submission within 14 working days after Senate approval. The preparation pack supports final Senate approval, NQF qualification documentation, review report, rationale statement and support letters.

tasks.name: PDQA NQF / NQA Recommendation
tasks.description: PDQA reviews the NQF or NQA submission pack from the department and prepares application documentation for initial submission or resubmission.

tasks.name: NQA / MQA Submission and Feedback
tasks.description: Submit the complete application to NQA or MQA and record the feedback received. Resubmission is tracked as a submission type and only the latest required version needs to be retained unless history is requested.

tasks.name: NQF / NQA Registration Record
tasks.description: Record the registration details after the qualification has been registered on the National Qualifications Framework.

tasks.name: Senate Need Analysis Approval
tasks.description: The department submits the Need Analysis documentation to Senate and Senate makes a decision on whether programme development may continue.

stages.name: Need Analysis
stages.description: Establish whether there is a justified need for the proposed programme through stakeholder consultation, PDQA review, BOS, APC and Senate consideration.

stages.name: Programme Development
stages.description: Appoint the Curriculum Development Coordinator and Programme Advisory Committee, then develop the draft programme for PDQA review.

stages.name: External Stakeholders Consultations
stages.description: Circulate the draft programme to PAC or PEC members and external stakeholders, benchmark with peer institutions, and prepare the final draft for PDQA recommendation.

stages.name: Internal Stakeholders Consultations
stages.description: Consult internal stakeholders on teaching, learning, assessment, delivery, cooperative education and quality assurance before institutional submission.

stages.name: BOS, APC and Senate Consultations
stages.description: Submit the final draft through BOS, APC and Senate so recommendations, deferments and approval decisions are formally recorded.

stages.name: NQF / NQA Registration
stages.description: Prepare and submit NQF documentation to the Namibia Qualifications Authority, record feedback, and capture the final registration details.

description: A programme development guide that follows the institutional process from Need Analysis to NQF/NQA registration, with clearer stage instructions, role-based responsibilities, reportable decisions, deferment reasons, and document requirements from the meeting change log.
